facts.fact: Replaces F887: the queen gives Usha a folded strip sealed in green wax with the sunbird at the Hill Gate and speaks its line aloud in Neela's hearing ('Ride with her. Press nothing.'). Usha never breaks the seal; she shows it whole at the third post to get fresh horses.

Retires F886 ('wait, I will be found'). Neela reads Ammu's jackal call 'tomorrow, I will find you' as 'don't decide without me', given on nights Neela went off alone to settle something not hers alone. Her last hearing of it was in the Resin House yard before Ammu drew Vellan off (F252), with Neela in shape.

Neela remembers Devan putting a river pebble in his cheek before the Company's count on the gorge vote and saying a flat, careful 'yes' to the result that sent her south; this grounds her fear of his voice in the coming vote.
At the night camp the question-for-a-question custom of the Resin House long table is used round the fire; Kuttu proposes it and Madhavi remembers it.
